* Add `ModelRequestRejectedError`, `ModelAuthenticationError` and `ModelNotFoundError` model error categories by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11081
* State loaded deferred capabilities' instructions in the system voice, append their changes, and show them to `before_model_request` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11103
